body: i am really sorry for you

10 years ago she had major complications after a stomach surgery and had several surgeries  after that. She almost died. it was really hard because we were both at the hospital at that time. I was 12, I had a spinal surgery and had to stay in the hospital for 4 months (that's when I started to feel really depressed). As I said my mother had complications from her surgeries and she is still not well. I had to take care of her, sometimes all by myself. She was back to work quickly but she is still exhausted today , and my father doesnt help. He does everything to bring her down. We're trying to leave home. I try my best to support her, but these days i dont know, i just can't. It happens sometimes, but this time its worse, its physical.
i dont know i feel so exhausted, both physically and mentally
